Hi, I am Priya. I am a sales coordinator in Pune, in India. My week is very regular. On Monday I always have two meetings: one with my team and one with the global team. On Tuesday and Wednesday I usually prepare quotes for our customers. I often follow up by phone, because many customers do not read long emails. I sometimes visit a factory, maybe once a month. On Friday I send the sales report to my manager. I never send it late, because my manager reads it on Friday afternoon. And the forecast? We update it every month, on the last Thursday.

Good morning. My name is Julien, and I am a purchasing manager in Lyon, in France. We make car seats, and we buy adhesives from three suppliers. How often do I place an order? Usually every two weeks, on Tuesday. Before I place an order, I always ask for a quote. I compare the prices, and then I decide. Do I visit my suppliers? Not often. Maybe two times a year. But I like it when a supplier follows up after a quote. It shows me that they care. And please, never send a quote after the deadline. I do not read it.
